_meta.purpose: The SHIELDED-SURVIVOR PROBE - deliberately populates the empty 4th cell of the 2x2 (internally fragile + high exposure + SHIELDED -> survives), with its discriminating contrast (same fragility + exposure, shield ABSENT/withdrawn -> falls). This is the observation neither the 51-case corpus, the random 30, nor the v2 cohorts return, because shielded survival is rare and undramatic.
_meta.discipline: EXPLICITLY NON-RANDOM and NON-BLIND - a targeted DISCRIMINATION PROBE, NOT an out-of-sample test. Hand-selected to test whether T3's response-patron axis tracks survival in internally-weak, highly-exposed states. NEVER folded into any out-of-sample/validation claim; firewalled from the 213/77/0 baseline.
_meta.internal_read: P1 = V-Dem rule-of-law at the pre-shock year (vdem_longrun.json); P5 = fragility estimate where no series. Exposure = citable COW-era data (approximate CINC, flagged).
_meta.decoupling: Kuwait motivates the deterrence-patron (E2, ex ante) vs response-patron (R3, ex post) split: Kuwait had NO deterrent (invaded) but a decisive response patron (coalition restored it).

Kuwait@1989.label: Kuwait, pre-1990 (FRAGILE + SHIELDED by response) -> invaded then RESTORED by coalition

engine_alone.note: militarily indefensible micro-state; internal capacity could not resist conquest (fell in 2 days)

internal_pillars.provenance: P1 = V-Dem rol @1989 = 0.625 (KWT); P5 low - no strategic depth, tiny armed forces

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW CINC c.1990 (approx); Iraq overwhelmingly stronger, battle-hardened post Iran-Iraq war

E2_patron.detail: DETERRENCE absent ex ante - no committed defender deterred Iraq (Saddam invaded Aug 1990). RESPONSE present ex post - the US-led UN coalition (Desert Storm) expelled Iraq and restored sovereignty Feb 1991.
E2_patron.provenance: ATOP (no pre-1990 defense pact) + historical record of Desert Storm

E3_contested_border.detail: Iraq's standing claim that Kuwait was its '19th province'.

Kuwait@1989.outcome_factual: Invaded by Iraq 2 Aug 1990; sovereignty restored by the coalition Feb 1991. SURVIVED via the response patron.

Bosnia@1995.label: Bosnia-Herzegovina 1995 (FRAGILE + SHIELDED) -> survives as a state only via external protection

engine_alone.note: genuinely fragile post-war state; statehood externally underwritten

internal_pillars.provenance: P1 = V-Dem rol @1996 = 0.347 (BIH); P5 floor - just out of a genocidal war

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW CINC c.1995 (approx); Bosnian govt forces weaker than Serb/FRY

E2_patron.detail: NATO airstrikes (Operation Deliberate Force, 1995) + Dayton + IFOR/SFOR/EUFOR external military protection sustained Bosnian statehood; it remains externally underwritten.

E3_contested_border.detail: Serb/Croat territorial claims and partition pressure.

Bosnia@1995.outcome_factual: Survived as a sovereign state (Dayton, Dec 1995) under sustained external (NATO/EU) protection.

Taiwan@1996.label: Taiwan 1996, Third Strait Crisis (DURABLE + EXPOSED + SHIELDED) -> persists
Taiwan@1996.cell: durable + extreme exposure + shielded -> survived (supporting, not the fragile cell)

engine_alone.note: internally strong by 1996 - NOT a fragility case; included to fill the top-right cell

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW CINC c.1996; PRC overwhelmingly larger

E2_patron.detail: US deterrence - Taiwan Relations Act + the 1996 carrier-group deployment to the Strait.

Taiwan@1996.outcome_factual: Crisis defused; Taiwan persists as a de-facto sovereign state.

Estonia@2003.label: Estonia 2003, pre-NATO accession (DURABLE + EXPOSED + SHIELDED) -> persists

engine_alone.note: internally very strong - NOT a fragility case; militarily tiny vs Russia, shielded by NATO (2004)

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW CINC c.2003; Russia vastly larger

E3_contested_border.detail: Border treaty disputes but no active conquest claim; Russian pressure short of territorial claim in 2003.

Estonia@2003.outcome_factual: Persists; NATO/EU member from 2004, no invasion.

Afghanistan@2019.label: Afghanistan (Islamic Republic) 2019 (FRAGILE + SHIELD WITHDRAWN) -> COLLAPSED 2021
Afghanistan@2019.cell: fragile + high exposure + shield WITHDRAWN -> fell (the discriminating CONTRAST)

engine_alone.note: very fragile; survived 2001-2021 ONLY on external (US) military backing

E1_relative_power.detail: Threat was the Taliban INSURGENCY (non-state), not an external state - so E1 (interstate relative power) is N/A. Flagged: this is an insurgency/patron-dependence channel, not pure interstate conquest. Included as the vivid shield-withdrawal contrast.

E2_patron.detail: External (US/NATO) military backing PRESENT 2001-2021 (held the state up), then WITHDRAWN Aug 2021 -> the Republic fell within weeks. response_patron=false captures the withdrawal at the decisive moment.

E3_contested_border.detail: Internal insurgency, not external territorial claim.

E5_great_power_faultline.detail: Long great-power contest (the graveyard of empires).

R4_strategic_depth.provenance: Afghanistan area - large, but no capacity to use it without the patron

Afghanistan@2019.outcome_factual: Survived 2001-2021 on external backing; collapsed within weeks of the US withdrawal (Kabul fell 15 Aug 2021). Shield removed -> fell.
Afghanistan@2019.flag: Impure for T3 (insurgency channel, not interstate conquest) - included as a real, vivid shield-withdrawal contrast; Cyprus 1974 is the cleaner unshielded interstate-conquest contrast.
